notes.title: Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36555240/7bf47eb9f6a9613d4d294a25bf149a0f3ead30d6.png[/img]

Hello, everyone!

We added new languages to the prologue chapter! Yay! We want to thank our friend, Biokube for helping us with the translation.

A Space for the Unbound - Prologue is now available in:
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Traditional Chinese
[/list]

We hope you will enjoy the game even more now that you can play it in your language.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36555240/1589b348191f62d689ca1e6f02a0ebea0648ea5b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36555240/488dfb8bcd8cd069cccc1bdf5835e684cceea951.jpg[/img]

Oh, one more thing.

Our studio is also working on this game, “When the Past was Around” and it’s coming to Steam next week! Help us wishlist the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164050/When_The_Past_Was_Around/

Cheers!

- - - - -

http://twitter.com/ASFTUgame

notes.title: New Languages Added to the Prologue!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36555240/7bf47eb9f6a9613d4d294a25bf149a0f3ead30d6.png[/img]

How are you all?

We’re very grateful and very delighted to announce that we have new language options for you to play in [b]A Space for the Unbound - Prologue![/b]  We hope by adding these new languages, the more people will be able to enjoy the game.

We want to thank our community for giving contribution and for showing endless support to this game. We're happy for all the love we've been receiving! Thank you! <3

Don’t miss Atma’s journey in exploring the town and diving into people’s mind by selecting your preferred language in the language options!

Here are the new languages added in this update.
[list]
[*] German
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish
[/list]

[i]Psst![/i] We also have new language to be added on August 8th, 2020. Stay tuned to see what it is ;)

Enjoy the story and don’t forget to wishlist the full game below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201270/A_Space_For_The_Unbound/

[i]Terima kasih![/i]

- - - - -
